selection_rule: value-based half-bin tolerance: (displacement_mm > 0.5*delta_u) & (displacement_mm <= 0.0010 + 0.5*delta_u) where delta_u = 2.5e-6 mm
provenance_diagnosis: In curve_1404933_extracted.csv, Row 0 is the un-deformed base state (u=0, F=0). Due to solver floating-point accumulation, increment 400 has u=1.0000000475e-3 mm. A zero-tolerance filter u <= 0.0010 mm drops increment 400, selecting only N=399 points and yielding the superseded value K0=137.821802 kN/mm (which was naively rounded to 137.822). Applying standard half-bin tolerance (u <= 0.0010 + 0.5*delta_u) correctly includes increment 400, giving the authoritative N=400 sample with K0=137.820804 kN/mm. Its proper mathematical roundings are: 6 decimals = 137.820804, 3 decimals = 137.821, 2 decimals = 137.82.
